Question
Count active subscriptions

Explanation

Summary
Intent count on data_query, rooted at subscription, limit 1000.

QuerySpec
{
  "intent": "count",
  "requested_entities": [
    "Subscription"
  ],
  "requested_fields": [],
  "filters": [
    {
      "concept": "Subscription Status",
      "operator": "equals",
      "value": "Active"
    }
  ],
  "metrics": [
    "Subscription Count"
  ],
  "dimensions": [],
  "group_by": [],
  "order_by": [],

  "backend_preference": "data_query"
}

Interpretation
Interpreted as count; entities: Subscription; fields: none.

Resolutions
Subscription Count → subscription_count (metric, confidence 0.95).
Subscription → subscription (object, confidence 1.0).
Subscription Status → subscription_status (dimension, confidence 0.95).

Filters
subscription.status = "Active".

Metrics
Metric: subscription_count.

Root
Planner selected subscription as the root object.

Join path
No joins required.

Inserted bridges
No bridge objects inserted.

Grain
Result grain: subscription.

Grouping
No grouping.

Limit
1000

Backend
Backend: data_query.

Assumptions
Natural-language interpretation is constrained to the supported MVP domain.
Generated SQL is a preview and is not executed by ZuQL.

Public canonical model limitation
ZuQL uses a public canonical model; tenant-specific fields, features, and mappings may differ.

Mapping status
Mapping status: 1 used object mapping(s) are convention-derived and unverified.

Warnings
Counts distinct subscription IDs to remain safe after one-to-many joins.
Data Query object subscription uses convention-derived physical name Subscription.

SQL
SELECT
  COUNT(DISTINCT "subscription"."ID") AS "subscription_count"
FROM "Subscription" AS "subscription"
WHERE "subscription"."Status" = 'Active'
LIMIT 1000
